title: Lynnphora's Urn

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Apologies, was I in the way?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apologies, was I in the way?

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Oh good! I'm always getting in the way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh good! I'm always getting in the way.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Oh I'm sorry. I'm always getting in the way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh I'm sorry. I'm always getting in the way.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: You know, just zigging instead of zagging. How are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, just zigging instead of zagging. How are you?

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: It's hard right now isn't it? What with the LUZ and weather. Nobody can catch a break.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hard right now isn't it? What with the LUZ and weather. Nobody can catch a break.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: As good as we can hope for maybe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As good as we can hope for maybe?

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Oh I'm glad!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh I'm glad!

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: I'm sorry, it must look like I'm attention seeking, walking around with this old thing all the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, it must look like I'm attention seeking, walking around with this old thing all the time.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: This here is Eugene. Say hello Eugene! ... I'm kidding, he's ashes now. Sorry if that joke made you uncomfortable!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This here is Eugene. Say hello Eugene! ... I'm kidding, he's ashes now. Sorry if that joke made you uncomfortable!

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: He'd have found you very funny! I'm not sure really. In all honesty, since he died it's been a bit of a challenge to know what to do with him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He'd have found you very funny! I'm not sure really. In all honesty, since he died it's been a bit of a challenge to know what to do with him.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: I'm not sure really. In all honesty, since he died it's been a bit of a challenge to know what to do with him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure really. In all honesty, since he died it's been a bit of a challenge to know what to do with him.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Coming up on eleven years now I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coming up on eleven years now I think.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: I know, I know. Of course I know. I'm not really sure why I'm struggling to let go. I mean, for all I know it's just sawdust in here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, I know. Of course I know. I'm not really sure why I'm struggling to let go. I mean, for all I know it's just sawdust in here.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: Really? Most people think I'm a crazy person. I feel I'm getting close, though. I'll know the spot when I find it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Most people think I'm a crazy person. I feel I'm getting close, though. I'll know the spot when I find it.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: I think about this a lot. He loved to go for a run on the beach but beaches are hard to find in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think about this a lot. He loved to go for a run on the beach but beaches are hard to find in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: I think you're right. I'll have a little think. Who knows, maybe next time you see me I'll be carrying a Zapperchino instead of this! Sorry for bothering you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're right. I'll have a little think. Who knows, maybe next time you see me I'll be carrying a Zapperchino instead of this! Sorry for bothering you.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: He also loved curling up on the sofa and resting his head on my lap but that doesn't really help me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He also loved curling up on the sofa and resting his head on my lap but that doesn't really help me.

nodes.speaker: Lynnphora Adams
nodes.text: When I finally had made up my mind, the LUZ happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When I finally had made up my mind, the LUZ happened.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, you're fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, you're fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, watch where you're going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, watch where you're going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really? Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm great!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm great!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Been better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Been better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's that you're holding?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that you're holding?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not at all!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not at all!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean kind of...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean kind of...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you walking around with him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you walking around with him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you walking around with him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you walking around with him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hello Eugene! Why are you walking around with him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello Eugene! Why are you walking around with him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hello Eugene! Why are you walking around with him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hello Eugene! Why are you walking around with him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When did he die?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When did he die?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow, that's quite a long time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow, that's quite a long time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wow, that's quite a long time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wow, that's quite a long time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should take your time, it's a big decision!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should take your time, it's a big decision!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You should take your time, it's a big decision!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You should take your time, it's a big decision!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would he have wanted?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would he have wanted?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds like he'd have wanted you to be happy. And maybe on a beach?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds like he'd have wanted you to be happy. And maybe on a beach?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It sounds like he'd have wanted you to be happy. And maybe on a beach?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It sounds like he'd have wanted you to be happy. And maybe on a beach?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I thought he died 11 years ago?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought he died 11 years ago?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I thought he died 11 years ago?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I thought he died 11 years ago?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything else?
